title: INT8 weight-only convergence validator and smoke suite for GPTQ/AWQ profiles
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Objective: Build a deterministic convergence validator and lightweight smoke test suite that validates INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) quantization profiles on the serving runtime and CI, with clear numerical backstops and automated fallbacks. Scope: - Integration of GPTQ and AWQ-derived profile artifacts into the QuantProfile registry. - A smoke harness that verifies numerical stability and answer fidelity across a representative prompt set (≈2k prompts spanning short/long sequences, instruction + conversational, few-shot). - A convergence validator that runs golden-seed sweeps and numerical delta checks (log-prob and token-level answer diffs) to guard against silent regressions. Out of scope: full long-run nightly fidelity sweeps (handled by a separate nightly pipeline ticket). Success metrics: - Median token-perplexity delta vs FP16 baseline < 1.5% across the prompt set. - Maximum answer-string token-delta threshold <= 3 tokens OR normalized string similarity >= 0.93 for generation tasks. - CI smoke must complete within 30 minutes on the standard verification instance to be used as a pull-request gate. Implementation notes and trade-offs: - We decided to prefer deterministic RNG seeds for validation runs; that improves reproducibility but underestimates variance in stochastic sampling production paths. To counter this we will run a small stochastic guard (3 seeds) in the nightly job later. - We will disable stochastic rounding during quantization verification to reduce noise in the validator; decision logged after numerical experiments (see updates). - Calibration set size selected at ~2k prompts balancing cost and sensitivity; increased sensitivity sets will run in nightly sweeps. - For models where AWQ profiles diverge from GPTQ beyond thresholds, we create per-model rollback rules: automatically mark the AWQ profile as 'stability-warning' and route traffic to GPTQ/FP16 in Dedicated fallback policies. Operational expectations: - Add telemetry hooks: token_logprob_deltas, answer_token_delta, profile_id, model_variant, seed, hw_type. - Expose a per-profile status in the QuantProfile registry: green/orange/red with last-validated timestamp and validation run id. - Integrate with Console rollout policies to fail fast for profiles in 'red'.
acceptance_criteria: Profiles from GPTQ and AWQ can be uploaded and indexed in QuantProfile registry with metadata (profile_id, quant_method, created_by, checksum).
PR gate job 'qprof-smoke-gptq-awq' exists in CI, runs within 30 minutes, and blocks merges when median perplexity delta > 1.5% or answer token delta thresholds exceeded.
Convergence validator implements golden-seed sweep and reports stable/nondeterministic flags and aggregates to telemetry dashboard.
Fallback rules are documented and an automated tag is set when a profile fails validation (registry status set to 'red').
Runbook section created with steps to triage numeric divergence, including artifact locations and sample commands.
